name: interface-summary-cwm-sol
description: Check the interface state during Pre and Post upgrade phase. If stash is passed as part of the input then the execution data is matched with the stash. This is done during post upgrade check. The interface data is returned in stash during the pre upgrade check. "Failure" is returned if there is some execution error. "Warning" status is returned if the stash data does not match with the execution data, otherwise "success" is returned.

definition.name: interface-summary-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

data.template:
Value InterfaceType (.*?)
Value Total (\d+)
Value Up (\d+)
Value Down (\d+)
Value AdminDown (\d+)

Start
  ^${InterfaceType}\s+${Total}\s+${Up}\s+${Down}\s+${AdminDown} -> Record

Value INSTANCE (\S+)
Value STATUS (\S+)

Start
 ^${INSTANCE}(\s+(\S+))(\s+(\S+))(\s+(\S+))(\s+(${STATUS}))(\s+(\S+))* -> Record

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is invalid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: Check if there is a difference in interface state
check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

logs.message: Getting differences in interface data between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .warnings += [.stash as $f1 | .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output as $f2 | ($f1 - $f2).[] as $f3 | reduce $f3 as {$AdminDown,$Down,$InterfaceType,$Total,$Up} (null; ($f2.[] | select(.InterfaceType == $InterfaceType) | ("For "  + $InterfaceType + " interface type, " + ("AdminDown" + (if((.AdminDown|tonumber)>($AdminDown|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $AdminDown + " to " + .AdminDown) else (if((.AdminDown|tonumber)==($AdminDown|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $AdminDown + " to " + .AdminDown)end) end)) + (", Down" + (if((.Down|tonumber)>($Down|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Down + " to " + .Down) else (if((.Down|tonumber)==($Down|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Down + " to " + .Down)end) end)) + (", Up" + (if((.Up|tonumber)>($Up|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Up + " to " + .Up) else (if((.Up|tonumber)==($Up|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Up + " to " + .Up)end) end)) + (", Total" + (if((.Total|tonumber)>($Total|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Total + " to " + .Total) else (if((.Total|tonumber)==($Total|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Total + " to " + .Total)end) end)))))] }

logs.message: Getting differences in interface data between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .warnings += [.stash as $f1 | .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output as $f2 | ($f1 - $f2).[] as $f3 | reduce $f3 as {$INSTANCE,$STATUS} (null; ($f2.[] | select(.INSTANCE == $INSTANCE) | ("For "  + $INSTANCE + ", " + ("Status" + (if(.STATUS!=$STATUS) then (" changed from " + $STATUS + " to " + .STATUS) else (" remained same") end) ))))] }

logs.message: Getting missing interfaces between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.stash[] | .InterfaceType]) - ([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .InterfaceType])) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [ ("Found missing interfaces - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) }

logs.message: Getting missing interfaces between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.stash[] | .INSTANCE]) - ([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .INSTANCE])) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [ ("Found missing interfaces - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) }

logs.message: Getting extra interfaces in current execution

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .InterfaceType]) - ([.stash[] | .InterfaceType]) ) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [("Found extra interfaces - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) | .status="warning" | .message="Differences are found in interface data in post-upgrade check." }

logs.message: Getting extra interfaces in current execution

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .INSTANCE]) - ([.stash[] | .INSTANCE]) ) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [("Found extra interfaces - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) | .status="warning" | .message="Differences are found in interface data in post-upgrade check." }
${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .rakutilExecutorData.message then .rakutilExecutorData.message else "Error while executing interface check mop activity." end)}}

logs.message: Creating stash for interface check. Interface pre-upgrade check is successful.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: (if .rakutilExecutorData.message != null then .rakutilExecutorData.message else "Exited abnormally" end)}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

logs.message: Interface check passed. No differences found in interface data between stash and current execution.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "success", "message": "No differences found in interface data in post-upgrade check.", "stash": .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output}}

definition.description: Check the interface state during Pre and Post upgrade phase. If stash is passed as part of the input then the execution data is matched with the stash. This is done during post upgrade check. The interface data is returned in stash during the pre upgrade check. "Failure" is returned if there is some execution error. "Warning" status is returned if the stash data does not match with the execution data, otherwise "success" is returned.
